messages:
kai: Heads-up: ran into a couple of annoying DX bits while iterating on the sample CLI. Wanted to surface them before the next onboarding wave.

maria: shoot, what happened?

kai: 1) `redwoodctl doctor` would have saved me 20 mins. we should add a one-command check for PATH/config/env sanity (which binary, config path, HTTPS_PROXY set, XDG issues). 2) while doing local serve + auth testing the device-code poll sometimes fails after a fast server restart.

leo: +1 for `doctor`. we keep getting duplicate bug reports about PATH collisions and proxy traps. what should doctor check?

kai: minimal: `which redwoodctl`, `redwoodctl --version`, `echo $XDG_CONFIG_HOME || ~/.config`, `ls config paths`, detect `HTTPS_PROXY`/`HTTP_PROXY`, and run a quick `curl --fail` to the local serve health endpoint if running. Print human hints for common fixes.

maria: for the auth poll flake: is this the keepalive socket reuse thing we've seen with port-forward and local-serve?

kai: yup. repro is quick: start `redwoodctl login --auth-method device`, then restart local server repeatedly. poll errors: `request canceled` or immediate 401. manual retry works.

leo: actionable: add a small retry with exponential backoff for the refresh/poll loop (3 attempts, jitter). expose via env `REDWOODCTL_AUTH_RETRIES` and CLI flag `--auth-retries`. default 0 for prod builds, 3 for dev builds.

maria: also update sample-app README to include a short troubleshooting section: PATH collisions, XDG vs /etc precedence, HTTPS_PROXY gotchas, and the `REDWOODCTL_NO_KEEPALIVE=1` workaround for quick local tests.

kai: +1. i also think doctor should detect multiple binaries on PATH and warn about mismatched client_id/version (common cause of redirect_uri 403). simple check: compare `redwoodctl --version` vs expected release.

leo: i'll open INF-3577 to add: 1) `redwoodctl doctor` command, 2) auth poll retry wrapper + env/flag, 3) sample-app doc updates with repro examples. will include a tiny e2e that simulates restarting the local server during device polling.

ci-bot: Issue INF-3577 created and assigned to @leo.

maria: thanks. if you want i can draft the doctor output text so it's helpful for new hires (one-liners and suggested commands).

kai: that would be great. i'll attach my repro script `scripts/repro-restart-poll.sh` to the issue.

leo: perfect. will ping when PR is up. tagging: `doctor`, `auth-poll`, `local-serve`, `xdg`, `proxy` :thumbsup:
